title: Vancouver Christmas Festival of Lights
includes: Private transportation by air-conditioned Mercedes Benz Sprinter van
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy the best of Vancouver Christmas Festival of Lights and Christmas Night Market with a Local Guide. Service is door to door - hotel pick up and drop off.

Vancouver Christmas Festival of Lights is a private tour tailored for guests who wants to experience the Christmas spirit and joy during the winter, see the colourful decorations and events, in luxury, and comfort. 

You will visit the Vancouver Christmas Night Market, Van Dusen Botanical Gardens, Capilano Canyon Lights, and/or Harry Potter Forbidden Forest Experience at Stanley Park, False Creek, Canada Place, and see and experience the colourful lights and special events of the season. There will be stops along the route, to explore and to take photographs (photo ops). 

It is perfect for everyone. Honeymooners, families, children, and seniors - this tour is a great fit for all.
